description: Defines classes, structs, and constants related to UCI indication handling in a scheduler, including UCI actions, timeout notifications, and the UCI indication selector logic.

classes.name: ocudu::uci_indication_timeout_notifier
classes.description: Abstract class for handling UCI grant timeout notifications.

classes.name: ocudu::uci_indication_selector
classes.description: Manages UCI indication processing, including handling UCI PDUs, timeouts, and feedback.

methods.name: handle_uci_ind_pdu
methods.description: Processes a UCI indication PDU received at a specific slot.

methods.name: handle_result
methods.description: Handles scheduler result at each slot.

methods.name: handle_discarded_ucis
methods.description: Resets UCI grants with pending feedback upon error indication.

methods.name: handle_uci_pdu
methods.description: Handles individual UCI indication PDUs and updates UCI entries.
